_comment: Waterbike AI skill tier limits. Read at runtime by plan_generator.py.
This file is the single source of truth for tier limits. If it is
missing or malformed the engine falls back to identical built-in
defaults and logs a warning, so a bad edit degrades rather than breaks.
Governed by Safety Canon v1.2 section 2. Changing any number here is a
change to the safety envelope and requires operator sign off.
night_expert is listed for reference but is deliberately absent from
planning_tiers: it is a credential to operate in darkness, not a higher
daytime tolerance. The engine emits daylight-only plans.
